programs.title: Mystery of the Lost Islands: Volcano Island
programs.desc: Dave Salmoni ventures to the Galápagos Islands in search of some of the weirdest and toughest animals on the planet.

programs.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Robert, King of Cobras
programs.desc: Robert wrangles Utah, a venomous 12-foot king cobra  Dr. Amber visits Pandora to care for wild koalas  back at the zoo, an old injury flares up for Bruce the brolga, a bird that has been in the Irwins' care for 26 years.

programs.title: Meet the Orangutans: Baby On The Way
programs.desc: A rehabilitated orangutan released to the wild ventures back to the sanctuary, the staff prepares for the birth of a new baby orangutan and the babies are tested with stinky fruit.

programs.title: Carter's W.A.R.: The Forgotten Giants
programs.desc: Not all poaching is for horns and tusks. In many parts of poverty-stricken Africa, giraffes are killed mercilessly for their meat. Ivan joins a specialized team in exploring radical solutions to save giraffes and provide food to communities.
